articles.title: Google Gemini 4 Argon closes the gap with OpenAI and Anthropic but doesn't take a clear lead
articles.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is Google's first frontier model in over seven months. It matches GPT-6 Astra in independent testing but can't keep up with Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5.
